email.subject: Website preview for Cafe Valley Coffee Shoppe
email.body:
Hello Cafe Valley Coffee Shoppe team,

I’m Amala from MultiMax. MultiMax is a small web development company that creates affordable websites for local businesses.

We found Cafe Valley Coffee Shoppe and noticed it did not have a dedicated website, so we prepared a website concept for your review.

Live website preview: https://amalraj020-a11y.github.io/10-am-office-work/

GitHub source: https://github.com/amalraj020-a11y/10-am-office-work/tree/main/sites/cafe-valley-coffee-shoppe

If you are interested, we can customize the website and continue at a small agreed budget. Please let me know.

Thank you,
Amala
MultiMax
